OIL FUNDS watch and wait as war drums beat louder

Investors made few changes to petroleum positions last week even as prices soared to four-month highs amid increasingly bellicose rhetoric from the United States and Iran about a possible resumption of fighting in the Gulf.

Hedge funds and other money managers purchased the equivalent of just 7 million barrels in the six most important futures and options contracts over the seven days ending on October 20, according to regulatory data ...

President Donald Trump is set to unveil a plan to dial back federal requirements designed to slash methane emissions from oil and gas operations, casting the proposal as a way to encourage more domestic energy production and lower costs.

Trump is expected to announce the proposed rule during a campaign rally in Lubbock, Texas, on Tuesday, as he tries to bolster the prospects of Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton in next week’s midterm elections, according to an administration official who asked not to be named before a formal announcement. #oott https://t.co/7PoSx1Ze5Z
